platform_sources.title: EnumDesktopWindows
platform_sources.meaning: Complete successful enumeration of a specific live HDESK observes its associated top-level windows. This is membership evidence, not cancellation, geometry-control or input authority.

platform_sources.title: GetThreadDesktop
platform_sources.meaning: Retrieves the specified thread desktop handle; failure returnsNULL with extended error. The official contract does not turn a failed query into evidence that the window is absent.

platform_sources.title: GetWindowRect
platform_sources.meaning: A separately attempted call returns success/failure and rectangle output. Default initialized storage when the call was not executed is not geometry evidence.

platform_sources.title: SetThreadDesktop
platform_sources.meaning: Assigns a desktop to the calling thread, not the input desktop. This observer connection cannot be described as SwitchDesktop or interactive testing.
